name: How much does engineering coordination cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What does engineering coordination typically cost for a luxury home project in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What does engineering coordination typically cost for a luxury home project in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineering coordination costs vary widely because the work may be bundled into a broader design or construction management fee, or billed separately by each consultant. A small remodel with limited technical complexity may require only a modest coordination effort, while a custom home, addition, or hillside project can involve structural, civil, MEP, geotechnical, and permit-related coordination that adds meaningful professional cost. The main cost drivers are the number of disciplines involved, how many revisions are needed, how difficult the site is, and whether city review comments force redraws. In Los Angeles-area luxury homes, coordination often pays for itself by reducing change orders, resubmittals, and construction delays. Homeowners should ask for a clear scope of coordination work, who is responsible for cross-discipline review, and whether extra revision cycles are included. If the fee seems unusually low, it may mean coordination is incomplete or not actively managed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineering coordination cost depends on project size, number of consultants, site complexity, and the amount of revision work needed. Smaller coordination efforts may be bundled into design services, while complex projects can require separate fees for structural, civil, MEP, and permit coordination. Hillside and custom homes usually cost more to coordinate.
